cells.meaning: v.使走投无路，使陷入困境；n.角落
cells.scene: A worried cat stands where two garden walls meet in a corner, two approaching dogs block its only forward route; no injury or violence. Clear being trapped with no escape, not merely a geometric corner.
A long curving sequence of distinct muddy animal footprints leads away through sparse grass; the whole series of traces is clear, one tiny animal silhouette at the far end.
Close view of one clearly indented large animal paw print pressed into soft brown mud, small paw shown lifted just above it; an impression left behind, no printer or book.
A wet leaf adheres tightly to the side of a blue raincoat sleeve; the person tries gently to peel it away. Focus on sticking closely to a surface, no embrace.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — corner (v.使走投无路，使陷入困境；n.角落): A worried cat stands where two garden walls meet in a corner, two approaching dogs block its only forward route; no injury or violence. Clear being trapped with no escape, not merely a geometric corner.
TOP RIGHT — trail (n.一串，一系列): A long curving sequence of distinct muddy animal footprints leads away through sparse grass; the whole series of traces is clear, one tiny animal silhouette at the far end.
BOTTOM LEFT — print (n.印痕): Close view of one clearly indented large animal paw print pressed into soft brown mud, small paw shown lifted just above it; an impression left behind, no printer or book.
BOTTOM RIGHT — cling (v.粘): A wet leaf adheres tightly to the side of a blue raincoat sleeve; the person tries gently to peel it away. Focus on sticking closely to a surface, no embrace.
